This file type is suitable for post files installed in the standard Mastercam Shared folder on the local PC. If you use a server or another non-standard location, you will need to manually install the post processor files. Save the attachment(s) to your PC before proceeding.&nbsp; 												 												 												&nbsp; 												 												 												To install the .mcam-content file, drag and drop it into an open session of Mastercam. Ensure the Mastercam version matches the version of the provided files. If it does not, please inform us.&nbsp; 												 												 												&nbsp; 												 												 												You should receive a message confirming the successful extraction of the files. If reinstalling existing post processor files, select the option to “Replace the original file in the destination folder” to ensure the latest files are installed. Occasionally, PC permission rules may prevent this process from working, requiring manual installation. To manually install the files, change the file extension to&nbsp;.zip, extract the contents, and install them manually.
